SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

7. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

10. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
